title: Design System: Spotlight Films — Video Production Studio

display.purpose: Headlines, CTAs, and anything the page asserts. Often italic.

wordmark.purpose: The studio name mark in the nav; shares the display family (Kanit), unlike the previous system's separate signature face.

motion.name: reveal-emergence
motion.value: opacity 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 1.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 1.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)
motion.purpose: Chemical-emergence reveal for media entering the viewport; brightness(0.15) blur(2px) scale(1.015) to clear. Media only, never typography.

motion.name: beam-drift
motion.purpose: Slow drift of the jade radial gradient on reel-plate/still-plate placeholders.

motion.name: scanline-flicker
motion.purpose: Low-opacity flicker on the reel-plate scanline texture.

motion.name: cta-sweep
motion.value: transform: scaleY(0)->scaleY(1), 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), origin flips top/bottom
motion.purpose: Ink curtain rises from the bottom on button hover, retracts on mouse-out.

motion.name: link-sweep
motion.value: 1px currentColor rule, scaleX(0) origin right at rest, scaleX(1) origin left on hover, 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1)
motion.purpose: Footer/link hover underline: sweeps in from the left, exits right on mouse-out.

motion.name: page-fly
motion.value: translateY(28px) scale(0.98) -> none on load (0.7s), translateY(-36px) scale(0.96) on leave (0.45s)

motion.name: hero-reel-parallax
motion.value: translateY(scrollY * 0.2) applied to the hero video only; heading/sub/CTA stay at native scroll speed
motion.purpose: Dissociates hero text from its background reel while scrolling.

motion.name: nav-dropdown
motion.purpose: 'My work' dropdown reveal in the takeover menu; hover on pointer devices, tap-toggle on touch.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's only CTA treatment — 'Book a call' / 'Get a quote'.
components.html: Book a call
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #ff5a1f; color: #000000; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-arrow { transition: transform 0.3s ease; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Full-bleed photo tile with bottom scrim and hover zoom; the client-segments grid's signature component.
components.html:
Corporate films

Interviews, brand stories, internal comms.
components.css: .ds-service-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; aspect-ratio: 3/4; border-radius: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 24px; } .ds-service-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.88) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 45%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%); z-index: 1; } .ds-service-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.9); transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 0.6s ease; } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-img { transform: scale(1.06); filter: saturate(1.05); } .ds-service-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: #f5f1ea; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-service-copy p { font-family: 'Bai Jamjuree', sans-serif; color: #b8b2a8; font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Floating Pill Nav
components.description: Fixed, inset, glass-surfaced nav shell that stays visible while scrolling, replacing the previous absolute scroll-away header.
components.html: FR / ENSpotlight Films
components.css: .ds-pill-nav { position: fixed; inset-inline: 16px; top: 16px; z-index: 50; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; background: rgba(13,13,13,0.78); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border: 1px solid rgba(245,241,234,0.1); } .ds-nav-lang { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b8b2a8; justify-self: start; } .ds-nav-word { font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f5f1ea; justify-self: center; } .ds-menu-toggle { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; justify-self: end; }

components.name: Reel Plate
components.description: Placeholder-footage treatment: projector-beam glow, scanline flicker, and film grain, standing in for real video or photography until it exists.
components.html: CommercialFootage coming soon
components.css: .ds-reel-plate { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: #000000; } .ds-reel-plate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -35%; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 40% at 32% 38%, rgba(255,90,31,0.24) 0%, transparent 62%); animation: ds-beam-drift 9s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-reel-plate::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(245,241,234,0.04) 0px, transparent 1px, transparent 3px); opacity: 0.5; } @keyframes ds-beam-drift { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(18%,14%) scale(1.15); } } .ds-reel-play { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0.2; } .ds-reel-label { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #b8b2a8; }

components.name: Devis Radio Card
components.description: Small-radius bordered label button used for the quote-request form's single-choice fields.
components.css: .ds-radio-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); } .ds-radio-card { display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(133,126,114,0.3); padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #b8b2a8; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-radio-sr:checked + .ds-radio-card { border-color: #ff5a1f; color: #ff5a1f; }

narrative.overview: This is a full replacement of the previous 'Projection Booth' world. The client asked for heavy structural and material inspiration from lusantprod.com, a video-production agency site — near-black ground, one saturated hot accent, bold italic display type, image-forward cards — translated into this site's own content, never its copy, photography, or exact hex values (the codebase records the accent deliberately shifted off the reference's #FF7300 to #FF5A1F for that reason). The result reads less like a screening room and more like an agency reel: a floating glass nav that stays present while you scroll, italic display headlines, and full-bleed photographic service cards with rounded corners standing in for what were previously plain full-bleed media or bare text sections.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (void/void-deep) lit by one saturated tangerine-orange accent, spent narrowly (primary CTAs, current-nav-state, focus, underline accents)
A persistent floating glass nav (.pill-nav) rather than a header that scrolls away
Bold italic Kanit display type for anything the page asserts; Bai Jamjuree for anything it explains
A three-step radius vocabulary — sharp structural elements, small-radius form controls, large-radius photo cards, and fully-rounded interactive pills — not a strict two-state system
Full-bleed photographic service cards (.service-card) with a bottom scrim and hover zoom, a new card language this world introduces that the previous system explicitly refused

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Tangerine is the only hue in the system besides ink/ash/void. It marks exactly one thing per view — a primary action, the current state, or an accent underline — never a decorative field or a second color introduced alongside it.

rules.name: The Assert/Explain Split
rules.body: Kanit (bold, often italic, uppercase) is reserved for anything the page asserts — headlines, labels, CTAs. Bai Jamjuree is reserved for anything it explains — paragraph copy.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from light, grain, and blur, never a drop shadow. Incumbent from the previous world; still holds.

rules.name: The Structural-Sharp Rule
rules.body: Page-level structure (sections, containers, dividers, hairlines) never carries a radius; radius is reserved for cards, controls, and interactive pills.

dos: Do keep the accent to one hue and one purpose per view: primary action, current state, or accent underline.

Do use .reel-plate/.still-plate — or clearly disclosed temporary stock photography — for anything standing in for footage or client work that doesn't exist yet; label it honestly rather than passing it off as final.
Do keep page-level structure (sections, containers, dividers) sharp; reserve radius for cards, controls, and pills.
Do give the nav its glass/blur treatment on every page so it reads over any content scrolling beneath it.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow to anything. Depth is light, grain, and blur, never a drop shadow.
Don't introduce a second accent hue alongside tangerine, even a muted one.
Don't fabricate a testimonial, client name, or credit in a placeholder slot — an honest 'coming soon' label beats a fictional one.
Don't treat the shipped hero eyebrow badge (a pill label above the H1) as a system device to reuse elsewhere — it is a carried defect, not a rule. See DESIGN.md's audit note.
